items.headline: RatchetProof is built and public — promote it to live, or leave it in beta?
items.detail: Built, gated and deployed 2026-10-19 (68db31a + 1a2c2c1), verified on the deploy image, and re-measured live on 2026-10-20: the page answers 200, computes the worked example, appears on /showcase, sits in /sitemap.xml (31 locs), and the agent descriptor is v2.2.0 with audit_demand_billing at $1.50/call. The open call is the beta-to-live promotion. It also gates the launch video: the video selector (src/lib/launch-video/plan.ts) picks only status 'live', so the detector reports zero pending and no video is produced while the status is beta (poster 404, ledger 5 rows).
items.impact: Promoting makes the sixth product a full live product and starts its launch video; leaving it beta keeps it public but outside the video pipeline.
items.reply: @Simon approve RatchetProof live  |  @Simon keep RatchetProof in beta

items.headline: Mark our own test visits so traffic numbers mean something
items.detail: Done 2026-10-19 (`18ff5f1`): one classifier marks our own suites, probes and browsers as internal, so visitor numbers now mean real people. Browser suites send the header, the metered agent route marks itself, and any of our browsers can be marked by visiting once with ?factory_internal=1. The growth check reports the visitor/internal/unclassified split and gates on visitors only; earlier rows stay unclassified rather than being re-labelled. Remaining: the traffic_class column migration (0004) waits on your Supabase SQL editor — the marker works without it, from the payload.
items.impact: Visitors are now countable; every traffic gate is scored on real people.

items.headline: One-line fix for the IDE header gap and gutter alignment
items.detail: Done 2026-10-19: the owner's `@Simon fix the header gap` was applied to the shared chrome. Three defects, all measured on the rendered DOM rather than argued from a screenshot: (1) `IdeTextarea`'s header still relied on `justify-between` alone, so at 375 px its badge box overran the bar and painted over the file title (measured −34.0 px on spendproof/caseproof/parcelproof/facturgate); both chrome bars now carry `gap-x-3` + `flex-wrap`, `min-w-0`/`truncate` on the title, `shrink-0` on the badge group, and print only the claim ("ZERO EGRESS") below `sm` with the full label returning at ≥640 px. (2) the Recovery-summary badge on /parcelproof was being squeezed into a two-line pill ("3"/"flags") by the description beside it — `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap` + `min-w-0` on the text block. (3) `tests/e2e/text-geometry.spec.ts` now measures the chrome BOXES (not glyph runs, and not skipping a clipped title) at 1280 px and 375 px on all four products; proven to bite by reverting the components (−34.0 px, 4 failed) and green with the fix. Gate: tsc, eslint 0 errors, 397/397 unit, build, 96/96 Playwright, visual-QA 24/24. Live: apps.aichieve.net/parcelproof and /caseproof measured after deploy.
items.impact: Closed — the chrome badge never touches the file title at 1280 px or 375 px, and a build-time geometry guard keeps it that way.

items.headline: A power-bill audit that shows what one peak costs for a year
items.detail: Done 2026-10-19 (68db31a product + tests, 1a2c2c1 gate-prompt/SOP fixes) — shipped live in beta and verified on the deploy, not on the push. Gate `scripts/verify-build.sh` printed "Verification passed." (tsc, lint 0 errors, tokens, 30 verticals, recon cadence, 416 vitest, 52 pages, 110 Playwright incl. axe/geometry/schematic, 30/30 Gemini tiles across 5 products). Deploy: container af8yqbwrrnyyfgs9wcg0intj-20261019T224403, image tag == 1a2c2c1710… == git rev-parse HEAD. Live measurements: /ratchetproof 200 and computes the worked example in a browser (complete, $4,500.00 carry-over, $2,250.00 counterfactual, 4 months, 4 ledger rows, the 1,400 kW Saturday spike reported as NOT billed, 0 page/console errors); unstated-clause example renders AUDIT BLOCKED with rp-tariff-unstated and no billed number; POST /api/ratchetproof/audit 400 rp-intervals-empty / rp-tariff-missing / rp-interval-gap ("never interpolated") and 200 complete on a two-meter coincident fixture (250 kW site peak, 0 variance), 200 blocked on an unstated ratchet; /.well-known/mcp.json 2.2.0 advertises audit_demand_billing at $1.50/call; /sitemap.xml carries /ratchetproof. The 503-when-unconfigured path is unit-tested and NOT reachable on this deploy (container carries GEMINI_API_KEY + LLAMAPARSE_API_KEY). Remains, owner's call: beta → live; PRD's $12 one-off / $39-mo per-site web tier is not wired to checkout in v1 (catalog exposes the $9 finding-set export; live site plans need Stripe products — a credentialed owner step); the first live tariff is the cost-measurement run that must confirm the $1.50 rate clears 3x its measured cost.
items.impact: Closed — a live beta audit that names the half hour which set the account's demand floor and prices it for the year, with the carry-over and the shave saving in dollars.
